others.deal: PlayReplay x Tennis Victoria Premier League

caption:
Valencia has sold 42% of the club to a US consortium.

Pitchwise Holdings has agreed to buy the stake from Peter Lim's Meriton at a €1.25bn valuation including debt, with €100m of new capital going into the club. KKR co-founders George Roberts and Henry Kravis and the Broncos' Penner Sports Group are among the backers. Meriton keeps control, and the deal still needs regulatory approval.

Also: Capital.com x Davis Cup, Midnite x UK Championship, PlayReplay x Tennis Victoria Premier League.
